timing.source: live sync, preprocess, IMU_init, deskew and final-iteration plane match instrumentation

criteria.clock: source scan header plus effective float curvature, ms; before deskew
criteria.early: acquisition strictly more than 1 microsecond after accepted end; exact and near-cut reported separately
criteria.surface_classes: within 20 degrees of gravity axis and >0.20 m above/below LiDAR origin for ceiling/ground candidates; within 20 degrees of perpendicular for wall candidates
criteria.residual: absolute signed point-to-plane distance from final accepted iteration, metres; each matched point counted once per update
criteria.initial_acceleration_units: message-native Livox axes, no m/s^2 conversion by driver
criteria.normal_tensor: unit plane-normal outer products in estimator world axes, invariant to normal sign

plane_translation_sensitivity.assumption: B1 initial world=IMU frame and uav.gravity_align_en=false
plane_translation_sensitivity.definition: sum((n dot u)^2)/N over final point-to-plane correspondences; unweighted translation sensitivity, excludes lever arm, covariance, visual/IMU constraints

attitude_elevation.coordinate_convention: extrinsic xyz roll pitch yaw; map_gravity<-body=R_GC @ R_Cbody; yaw has no external reference
